svg.title: Chapter VI · A fire for VAVE
svg.desc: Square pixel-art chapter card VI of VIII, titled VI · A fire for VAVE in pixel letters in the night sky. A big campfire burns in front of a lit trade-fair booth at night. The booth has a truss with spotlights, a header that reads VAVE.LOG, a calendar screen and a clock screen on the wall, and a counter. Pix stands next to the fire.
